### Watermelons

 Harvest when the underside turns yellow or the fruit produces a dull sound when slapped.
 Store in a cool spot (55 degrees Fahrenheit) in the kitchen in perforated plastic bags. Storage in the refrigerator is also possible for a few days.
 Watermelon will decay if stored below 50 degrees Fahrenheit for more than a few days.
 The expected shelf-life is two weeks.

 Harvest when leaves are still tender.

results.description:
Title: Keep food safe with time and temperature control | UMN Extension
# Keep food safe with time and temperature control. A leading cause of foodborne illness is time and temperature abuse of **TCS** (food requiring **time** and **temperature control for safety**) foods. TCS foods are time and temperature abused any time they’re in the temperature danger zone, 41 to 135 degrees Fahrenheit. * Not cooked to the recommended minimum internal temperature. * Not held at the proper temperature. Temperature danger zone: 41 to 135 degrees Fahrenheit. The longer food is in the temperature danger zone, the more time pathogens have to grow. The goal is to reduce the amount of time TCS food spends in the temperature danger zone. If food is held in this range for four or more hours, you must throw it out. ## Time and temperature. For a quick and reliable reference, print a copy of the Minnesota Department of Health fact sheet, Temperature Requirements for Potentially Hazardous Foods. ### Cold holding - 41 degrees Fahrenheit or less. Cold foods must be maintained at 41 F or less. The following MUST be cooked to listed internal temperatures and times:. #### 145 Fahrenheit or above for 15 seconds
